_setup_steps: 1. Copy your .env.example to .env and fill in all API keys
4. Log into the dashboard and configure Agent + Availability
5. The backend auto-creates the Vapi assistant on first agent save
6. Or use this JSON to manually create via Vapi API / dashboard
7. Set your Vapi phone number to use this assistant
